zh.title: Jev 聊天助手安装与设置：从选择平台到第一条候选回复
zh.description: 先确认设备，再配置模型接口与读屏权限。本文说明 Android 的设置顺序、桌面版入口、费用和聊天数据去向。
zh.body:
先选平台，再照对应说明操作

Jev 的项目主页汇总 Android、Windows、macOS 三个独立维护的版本。下面的无障碍、悬浮窗和 OCR 步骤针对 Android；电脑端请从项目主页进入相应项目，按那里的说明配置。

平台官网当前列出的要求下一步
AndroidAndroid 11+，ARM64按下文安装和设置
WindowsWindows 10 1903+ / 11在主仓库选择 Windows 项目
macOSmacOS 13+，Apple Silicon在主仓库选择 macOS 项目

当前没有 iOS 版或可直接使用的网页版。获取入口统一在 GitHub 项目主页，具体兼容性以各端发布说明为准。

1. 获取并安装 Android 包

打开主仓库的「开始使用 Jev」，选择 Android 安装包。先核对系统版本与芯片架构；ARM64 之外的设备不在本页所述支持范围。

如果此前装过 debug 包，可能因签名不同无法覆盖安装。卸载会清除密钥和设置，操作前先确认需要保留的信息。普通版本升级后，可把系统无障碍开关关闭再打开，使服务重新绑定。

2. 配置模型接口，并测连通

打开 App 的「设置 → 接口」，可以看到判断、回复、视觉三张接口卡。按当前 README，起步可在判断接口填入自己的 OpenRouter API Key，其余两张留空继承配置；也可以为各路单独选择接口和模型。

  1. 确认服务商地址、模型与密钥相互匹配。
  2. 用接口卡上的连通测试检查配置。
  3. 连通后再回到聊天场景，排查读屏和权限。

软件开源免费不等于模型请求免费。费用由你选择的接口服务商按其规则收取。不要把 API Key 写进截图、Issue 或公开文档。

3. 按 App 向导开启必要权限

  • 无障碍：读取当前支持的聊天界面。
  • 悬浮窗：在聊天旁显示分析和候选回复。
  • 自启动与省电设置：部分系统会冻结后台，需按系统和 App 指引设置；小米 / HyperOS 尤其要检查这一项。

重装后，悬浮窗权限可能需要重新开启。权限设置只决定能否读取和显示内容，不会替代模型接口配置。

4. 用一段非敏感对话检查完整流程

在当前兼容列表支持的聊天场景中，先用不含敏感信息的内容试用：确认识别文字与屏幕一致，查看判断与候选，再选择复制或填入。检查措辞后由自己点击发送。

官网当前记录了 QQ、X 私信的验证情况，以及飞书通过 OCR 补正文的情况；它们不代表任意 App 版本和任意语言界面都已验证。请先查看官网兼容性说明。

遇到问题，按出现的位置检查

  • 接口连通失败：先检查接口地址、模型名、密钥和服务商状态。
  • 有悬浮球但没有文字：检查无障碍、聊天界面和兼容范围；OCR 只能读取屏幕上可见的文字。
  • 悬浮球消失：检查后台、自启动与省电设置，重装后重新检查悬浮窗权限。
  • 读到文字但建议不合适：先核对 OCR 和上下文，再调整候选。模型判断不是确定结论。

使用前理解数据会发给谁

Android 的截图识别在本机完成；触发分析时，聊天文字和你启用的背景信息会发给你配置的模型接口。离线 OCR 不代表整个分析过程离线。服务商如何处理请求内容，应查看其政策及 Jev 的隐私政策。

本文是按已公开项目资料整理的操作指南，不是对所有设备的独立实测报告。来源：项目 README及官网兼容说明。
zh.cta: 先在主仓库选择平台，再按该平台说明完成设置。

en.title: Set up Jev Chat Assistant: choose a platform and generate your first reply options
en.description: A practical Android setup guide covering model endpoints, accessibility, overlay permissions, costs and where chat data goes. Desktop editions have separate instructions.
en.body:
Choose the platform before following setup instructions

The main Jev repository links to separately maintained Android, Windows and macOS editions. The accessibility, overlay and OCR steps below describe Android. Follow each desktop project’s own instructions for Windows or macOS.

PlatformRequirements currently listedNext step
AndroidAndroid 11+, ARM64Follow the steps below
WindowsWindows 10 1903+ / 11Choose the Windows project from the main repository
macOSmacOS 13+, Apple SiliconChoose the macOS project from the main repository

An iOS edition and a browser version are not currently available. Start from the GitHub project homepage and check the release notes for your platform.

1. Get and install the Android package

Use the Android entry in the main repository. Check the Android version and CPU architecture first; this guide covers ARM64 devices.

A previous debug build may have a different signature and prevent an in-place update. Uninstalling removes settings and keys, so account for anything you need to retain first. After a normal upgrade, turn accessibility off and on again to rebind the service if necessary.

2. Configure and test the model endpoints

In the app’s endpoint settings, there are separate cards for judgment, reply generation and vision. The current README describes starting with your OpenRouter API key in the judgment card and leaving the other two blank to inherit it. You can also configure each route independently.

  1. Make sure the provider address, model name and API key match.
  2. Run the connection check on the endpoint card.
  3. Once the endpoint works, test screen reading in a supported chat.

Free open-source software does not imply free model calls. Your chosen provider sets API charges. Keep keys out of screenshots, issues and public documents.

3. Follow the app’s permission guide

  • Accessibility: reads the supported chat interface currently on screen.
  • Overlay: displays analysis and reply options beside the chat.
  • Autostart and battery settings: some devices freeze background apps. Check the device and app instructions, particularly on Xiaomi / HyperOS.

Reinstalling may reset overlay permission. Permissions allow capture and display; they do not replace model endpoint configuration.

4. Check the full flow with non-sensitive content

Try a supported chat with non-sensitive text. Compare the recognized words with the screen, inspect the assessment and reply options, then copy or fill a candidate. Review it before pressing Send yourself.

The website records verification for QQ and X direct messages, and OCR-assisted text capture for Feishu / Lark. This does not establish support for every app version or interface language. Read the compatibility notes first.

Troubleshoot the stage that fails

  • Endpoint test fails: check the address, model, key and provider availability.
  • The bubble appears but no text is captured: check accessibility, the current screen and compatibility. OCR can only read visible text.
  • The bubble disappears: check autostart, background and battery settings, and permissions after reinstalling.
  • The text is correct but a reply is unsuitable: check the context and edit the candidate. An assessment is not a certain conclusion.

Know where the data goes

Screenshot recognition happens locally on Android. When you request analysis, chat text and enabled background context are sent to the model endpoint you configure. Local OCR does not make the whole process offline. Review the provider’s policy and the Jev privacy summary.

This guide is based on public project documentation, not an independent test across all devices. Sources: the project README and website compatibility notes.
en.cta: Choose your platform in the main repository and follow its setup instructions.

zh.title: AI 给出的回复怎么用？发送前检查这四件事
zh.description: 用一个明确标注为虚构的对话示例，说明怎样核对事实、减少误读、检查承诺，并把 AI 候选改成自己愿意发送的话。
zh.body:
下面的聊天和候选都是为解释方法而编写的虚构示例，不是真实聊天记录，也不是一次 Jev 实测输出。

从一句不确定的话开始

对方：「那就这样吧。」

这句话可能表示事情已谈妥，也可能表示疲惫或不愿继续。缺少前文时，不能把某一种解释当成事实。Jev 可以提供判断和回复候选，但最后仍要结合你知道的情境。

1. 先核对它读到了什么

先看识别文字有没有漏掉否定词、时间或主语。OCR 只能读取屏幕上可见的部分，截断的长消息和识别错字都会改变意思。上下文不完整时，先补看前文，比立刻选一条候选更有用。

2. 把意图判断当作待核实的解释

不要因为模型给出风险等级或概率，就认定对方生气、撒谎或抱有某种动机。对于上面的例子，可以先确认：「你是觉得已经说清楚了，还是想先停一下？」这是一种澄清写法，不是通用的标准答案。

3. 找出候选里新增的事实和承诺

例如候选写「我今晚一定处理完」，发送前先确认今晚是否真的能完成。如果你还不知道时间，可以改成「我先确认一下安排，再告诉你能什么时候处理」。这也是虚构的改写示例；具体写什么取决于实际情况。

  • 有没有编造一个你没说过的原因？
  • 有没有承诺金额、期限、结果或见面安排？
  • 有没有暴露不应分享的他人信息？
  • 措辞是否像你平时说话，是否符合这段关系？

4. 先编辑，再决定是否发送

复制或填入只是把候选放到输入框。读一遍，删掉不属实的部分，必要时改成一个短问题；也可以暂时不发。Jev 的设计保留手动发送，这一步是使用流程的一部分。

哪些情况更需要谨慎理解

项目的已知限制包括中文判断波动、群聊按一对一处理，以及 OCR 可见范围和错字问题。AI 给出的建议不适合用来给关系下定论。你可以在官网问答与限制查看当前公开口径。

如果启用知识库、联系人或历史，它们可能作为分析背景发送给配置的模型接口。只填写你有权处理、愿意交给该服务商的信息；详见隐私政策。
zh.cta: 了解 Jev 如何展示判断与候选，再决定它是否适合你的聊天场景。

en.title: How to review an AI-written reply before sending it
en.description: Use a clearly fictional conversation to check captured text, uncertain interpretations, invented facts and commitments before turning an AI candidate into your own message.
en.body:
The conversation and reply examples below were written to explain a method. They are fictional, not private chat records or observed Jev test outputs.

Start with an ambiguous sentence

“Let’s leave it there.”

The speaker might consider the matter settled, feel tired or want a pause. Without context, none of those interpretations is established. Jev can provide an assessment and reply options, but you still need to relate them to what you know.

1. Check what was captured

Look for missing negatives, times and subjects. OCR can only read visible text, so clipped messages and recognition errors can change the meaning. If context is missing, reading the earlier conversation may help more than immediately picking a candidate.

2. Treat intent as an interpretation to verify

A risk score or probability does not establish that someone is angry, dishonest or acting with a particular motive. For the fictional sentence above, a clarifying option could be: “Do you feel we’ve settled it, or would you like a break?” It is an example of clarification, not a universal answer.

3. Identify new facts and commitments

If a candidate says “I’ll definitely finish it tonight,” first check whether that is realistic. If you do not know yet, you might write: “Let me check my schedule and tell you when I can handle it.” This is another fictional rewrite; use wording that matches the real situation.

  • Does the candidate invent a reason you never gave?
  • Does it commit you to a deadline, payment, result or meeting?
  • Does it disclose another person’s information?
  • Does the wording sound like you and fit the relationship?

4. Edit, then decide whether to send

Copying or filling only puts the candidate into the input box. Read it, remove unsupported details and consider a short question where clarification would help. Choosing not to send yet is also an option. Jev keeps sending manual.

Keep the documented limitations in mind

The project notes variable quality in Chinese, one-to-one treatment of group chats and OCR limitations. A suggestion should not be used to decide what a relationship means. See the published questions and limitations.

Enabled notes, contact information and history may be sent as context to your configured model endpoint. Include only information you are entitled to process and willing to share with that provider. Read the privacy summary.
en.cta: Learn how Jev presents assessments and candidates, then decide whether it fits your situation.
